'''Rusa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was the daughter of [[Bahlea]] and [[Bahlea's husband|her husband]], who were [[Pilgrims]] from [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. When she fell sick, her father went searching for [[Manka cat/Legends|manka cat]] teeth to use in a medicine for her. He was killed by [[Flesh Raider]]s, but Rusa's mother asked a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] from the nearby [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to find his body. The Padawan recovered the teeth and brought them back to Bahlea, who used them to heal her daughter.
